spotify_public.title: Spotify Client ID
spotify_public.description: From developer.spotify.com/dashboard — create an app, then copy its Client ID here. Spotify will not let this read your history without one.

spotify_secret.title: Spotify Client Secret
spotify_secret.description: From the same page as the Client ID.

file_explorer_enabled.title: File explorer
file_explorer_enabled.description: A lightweight, password-protected, read-only browser for this app's own data — handy for pulling a file out or checking what's actually stored, without needing a terminal. The password is generated for you and shown once the app finishes starting.

yolab.description: Injected by local-api at install time; not user-editable.
